memories.text:
function: Independent in all ADLs; walks to nearby market; no difficulty climbing stairs.
cognition: Mini-Cog score 4/5 (recall 3 items, clock draw normal); no concerns.
falls: No falls in last 12 months; gait normal; TUG 9 seconds (low fall risk).
medicines: 3 regular (pantoprazole 40 mg OD, domperidone 10 mg BD, calcium 500 mg OD); no polypharmacy.
mood: Reports good spirits; denies anxiety or depression.
carers: Husband Rajesh, spouse.
goals: "I want to stay active and enjoy my work without heartburn."

memories.text: Upper GI endoscopy: Mild erosive esophagitis (Los Angeles Grade A) in distal esophagus; no Barrett’s epithelium; stomach mucosa normal; duodenum normal.

memories.author: D06
memories.text: Endoscopy report received: Mild erosive esophagitis, Grade A. No malignancy. Recommend continued PPI therapy, lifestyle modification, and repeat endoscopy in 1 year if symptoms persist.
